svg.title: Market Row — Three working shops
svg.desc: Forge yard, armor gallery and arcane loft each have a working ground entrance. Continuous awning tops make a second shopping route. Editable design layers: architecture, walkable ledges, supported climbs, jumpable props, numbered exits and NPCs.

g.text: Climbable stairs / ladders / ropes · pale edges are landable
Solid route stays open · furniture tops add optional hops

svg.text: Forge yard, armor gallery and arcane loft each have a working ground entrance. Continuous
awning tops make a second shopping route.
7 raised landings · 2 stair flights · 3 rope climbs · 2 ladders · 20 placed props
R = same-map recovery · structural concept, not an exported collision mesh
1 Brann · weapons · 2 Tessa · armor · 3 Orin · arcane stall
